paite: Huan Saul tapa Ishboshet in Hebron ah Abner asi chih ana zak in akhutte ahong hat kei ua, Israel mi tengteng apatau uhi.
heading: Ishboshet Thah In A-om

paite: Saul tapa Ishboshet in sepaih pawl heutu nih anei hi. Khat min Baanah ahi a, adang min Rekab ahi. Amau Benjamin suan Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate ahi uh. Beeroth bel Benjamin nam a simtel a ngaih ahi.
Beeroth a mite Gittaim ah atai ua, tuni tan in huai ah ateng uhi.

Saul tapa Jonathan in tapa khebai anei hi. Jezreel a pan Saul leh Jonathan tanchin ana theih in kum nga a upa ahi. Amah donnu in apom a, ataimangpih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, taimang dia akintatna lam in akesak a, akhe hong baita hi. Ama min Mephibosheth ahi.
Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate Rekab leh Baanah apai ua, Ishboshet inn ah sun nisat laitak a lupna a alup lai in akiang ah ahoh uhi.
Huit buh la ding hileh kilawm in insung lam ah alut ua, anakguh ngana nuaitak ah adawt ua, huchi in Rekab leh a-unaupa Baanah ataimang uhi.
Inn ava lut un alupna dantan a lupna a lum lai ava dawt ua, athat ua, alu atan ua, alu ala uh. Arabah kantan in zankhua in apaimang uhi.

Ishboshet lu Hebron ah David kiang ah ahon pua ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, nang hon thah tum, na melma Saul tapa Ishboshet lu hiai ah a-om; TOUPA'N ka toupa phu Saul leh asuante tung ah tuni in alaksakta," achi uhi.
David in Beeroth mi Rimmon tapa Rekab leh a-unaupa Baanah adawng a, akiang uah, "TOUPA ka mangbatna tengteng a hon tanpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi.
Tanchinhoih hon tun akisep in, 'Ngai in, Saul asita, chi a mi khat in ahon hilh lai in, amah ka man a, Ziklag ah ka that hi'. Huai atanchinhoih hon puakman a ka na piak ahi.
Midiktat, ama insung a ama lupna tung ngei a lum, migilou in athah uh sisan man na tung uah ka hon phut nawn sem dia, leitung a pan alamang kei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in David in atangvalte thu apia a, amaute athat uh. Akhutte uleh akhete uh atansak ua, Hebron a dil tung ah akhai uhi. Ishboshet lu bel ala ua, Hebron a Abner han ah avui uhi.
